headline: Born to Ride™ High-Waist Equestrian Leggings — All-Over Print | XS–3XL

bullets: 🐎 All-over equestrian print — horseshoes, snaffle bits & jumping-horse silhouettes wrap 360°, no boring side seams cutting the design.
🍑 Squat-proof & fully opaque — high-waist compression fabric stays put mucking out, tacking up or in the saddle.
💨 Buttery-soft + sweat-wicking — 4-way stretch keeps you cool from early barn chores to an evening schooling session.
📏 True size XS–3XL — inclusive fit with a hidden waistband pocket for your phone, treats or keys.
🎁 Match the set — pair with the matching equestrian all-over-print sports bra for a full barn-to-street look.
body_copy.description:
**For the rider who thinks about horses all day.**

You don't just ride — you live it, from the 6am feed to the last evening turnout. These high-waist leggings put your favourite world right where everyone can see it: a bold all-over print of horseshoes, snaffle bits and jumping-horse silhouettes that wraps all the way around, so you look just as good at the yard as you do on the school run.

Made from a thick, buttery-soft performance blend, they hold you in without squeezing, stay completely opaque through deep squats and mounting, and wick sweat so you stay dry through a full day at the barn. The high waistband smooths and supports, and there's a hidden pocket for your phone or a pocketful of treats.

Schooling, hacking, or the supermarket after — these are the leggings you'll reach for every single time. **Reins in. Print on.**
body_copy.size_guide: Inclusive XS–3XL. Measure your natural waist and hips (cm and inch); if between sizes, size up for a relaxed fit. Waist XS ~60-64cm/24-25in → 3XL ~112-120cm/44-47in (full cm/inch chart on size-guide image slot #5). True to size for most riders.
body_copy.care_info: All-over sublimation print — the pattern is dyed into the fabric and will not crack or peel. Machine wash cold inside-out, mild detergent, no bleach, no fabric softener. Hang dry or tumble low. Do not iron directly on the print.
